paragraphs.text: One DSH composer plugin: direct model picker, draggable reasoning-effort rail, and a DeepSeek accoun
t hider. DSH 输入框三合一插件：模型选择 + 拖动强度条 + 隐藏 DeepSeek 账号
dsh-composer-plus
One plugin, four things: model picker + draggable reasoning-effort rail + DeepSeek account hider + r
ight-click file actions.
中文 | English
## What it is
`dsh-composer-plus` is a pure front-end plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) **web client**. It fol
ds the composer's right-hand controls into one pill:
| Feature | What it does |
| **Model picker** | Click the model name to get a provider-grouped list (no submenu). A pick applie

s immediately. |
| **Effort rail (drag bar)** | A notched slider: click, drag, or use `←`/`→`/`Home`
/`End`. Levels come from each model's own `reasoningEfforts`; the top level gets a gradient sweep an

d halo. |
| **Hide DeepSeek account** | The bundle patch disables the official account entry (sideba
r account menu, account settings page, credential onboarding), and the custom model menu filters the

`deepseek-account` channel. |
| **File context menu** | Right-click a changed-files card, a deliver
ed file card, a file-tree row, or a rendered file-path link: open it in the sidebar or show it in Fi

nder (Explorer / the default file manager on other platforms). |
| **Theme-aware** | Every color bin

ds to `--dsw-alias-*` theme variables, so light/dark and third-party skins stay readable. |
| **Zero
intrusion** | A modular bundle: no core changes, nothing written outside the profile, clean removal
trusion** | A modular bundle: no core changes, nothing written outside the profile, clean removal. |
The file menu reuses shipped capabilities: the target's own click, the `shell.overlay` / `Menu` / `T
oast` primitives, and the Session Remote's `openWorkspacePath({ action: 'reveal' })` (the Host runs
`open -R` on macOS), so it adds no host route.
## Compatibility
- dsh **0.1.5+** (the `ctx.modelDirectories` / `session/selectModel` generation) and a **web client*

* (`dsh web`, or the web UI inside the desktop app).
- End-to-end tested on dsh **0.2.1-rc.2**: mode
l switching, drag + keyboard effort changes, light/dark themes, no account entry in Settings, and th

e file context menu.
- The rail only appears for models that declare reasoning levels; other models

show the picker alone.
- The plugin draws into the composer's `conversation.input.right` seat and tu
cks the native model trigger away. If a future dsh changes the composer DOM and the native trigger i

s not hidden, please open an issue.
- The file menu recognizes dsh's DOM contracts (`data-changed-fi
les`, `data-presented-file`, `data-files-path/entry`, and path-link buttons carrying a `title`). If
a later dsh renames one, the menu stays quiet instead of hijacking unrelated right-clicks.

### Desktop app
The desktop profile is managed by the Electron app (`dsh plugin --profile desktop` is refused). Inst
all this bundle from the app's **Plugins** page (GitHub repo or a local directory), then restart the
app. If your build has no such entry, validate on a web profile first and point the app at that pro
If your build has no such entry, validate on a web profile first and point the app at that profile.
> The plugin participates in profile composition, so install/remove needs one app restart; CSS/clien
t-only changes only need a refresh.

## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart `dsh web` / the app. The plugin stores no runtime data; the last selected effort stays
in dsh's own session state.
## Layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
There is no build step: `lib/client.js` is a browser-executed `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})`
factory and React comes from the dsh module table.
## Known limits
- Account hiding is **patch-layer disable + client-side fallback**: another plugin that re-adds acco

unt UI can override it; disable that plugin first.
- The account-model filter only affects this plug

in's menu; the native `/model` popup is still dsh's (use it to pick an account model temporarily).
-

Web client only; headless/TUI profiles never render the composer.
- The file menu only acts on file
elements the UI already renders; a plain-text path in a message that is neither a link nor a file c
already renders; a plain-text path in a message that is neither a link nor a file card gets no menu.
